head: git
push
rules.message: Avoid `git push --force` here — it was corrected by the human 2×. The human said: "stop force pushing, I told you yesterday". Use the safer alternative, or ask first.

This shell is zsh: an unquoted word starting with `=` (`===`, `[ a == b ]`) is expanded as a command path and fails — quote it or use `[[ … ]]` (failed 3× (zsh-equals) across 2 sessions). Worked before: `echo "=== Build done ==="`
